comments.body:
### nc-review: comments — 1 important, 1 nit

@pcbeingused333 — a few things worth a look, none blocking.

The PR adds `modelParameters` to the `modeOverrides` the plain (`--plain` / `nanocoder run`) loop builds, so tune's `temperature`/`maxTokens`/`reasoningEffort` reach the AI SDK exactly as the TUI loop already does; I verified the chat handler reads them only from `modeOverrides.modelParameters`, that the plain shell resolves `tune` through `resolveTune` (config + provider + preferences) and passes it down, and that the new spec fails without the change (without it `seen[0].modelParameters` is `undefined`). The fix itself is correct, minimal, correctly scoped and shipped with a valid changeset (`@nanocollective/nanocoder`, patch), and it is ready to merge; the only outstanding point is that the "tune enabled -> apply model parameters" rule is now hand-copied into a second frontend (and still missing from a third), which is how this bug happened in the first place.

**🟠 important · `design` · `source/plain/conversation.ts:335`**

The gate that decides whether a user's tune settings reach the model is now written out a second time:

```ts
// source/plain/conversation.ts (new)
modelParameters: tune?.enabled ? tune.modelParameters : undefined,

// source/hooks/chat-handler/conversation/conversation-loop.tsx:264 (existing)
const modelParameters = tune?.enabled ? tune.modelParameters : undefined;
```

The codebase already has exactly this shape of helper for the neighbouring concern — `getTuneToolMode(tune)` in `source/types/config.ts` — and the plain loop and the TUI loop both call it. This PR is itself the drift that helper exists to prevent: the plain loop forgot the rule, so users' `temperature`/`maxTokens` were silently dropped in one surface. Now that a third frontend (ACP) needs the same rule, the copy-paste will be extended rather than centralised.

What would fix it: add `getTuneModelParameters(tune: TuneConfig | undefined): ModelParameters | undefined` next to `getTuneToolMode` in `source/types/config.ts`, and call it from the TUI loop, the plain loop and the ACP adapter instead of re-deriving the condition inline.

**⚪ nit · `completeness` · `source/acp/acp-conversation.ts:426`**

The ACP surface still has the identical gap this PR fixes for `--plain`: `prepareTurn` builds `modeOverrides` with `nonInteractiveMode` / `nonInteractiveAlwaysAllow` / `nativeToolsDisabled` only, so `nanocoder --acp` continues to ignore tune's model parameters even though `source/acp/acp-agent.ts` already resolves `tune` per session. This is outside the PR's stated scope (it targets `--plain` / `nanocoder run`) and no issue is closed, so it does not block merging — but it is worth a follow-up so the frontends converge, ideally as part of the shared-helper change above rather than as another copy of the rule.

---

<sub>🔴 blocking · 🟠 a reviewer would ask for a change · ⚪ optional</sub>

<sub>Automated code review — correctness, security, design, tests, plus duplicates and scope. A human still decides; this is not a substitute for review and is not exhaustive. The required status checks separately cover lint, formatting, types, unused dependencies, the test suite and the build. This bot never merges. Maintainers can rerun with `/re-review`.</sub>
